description: A fill companion node that fills each area with a random grayscale value

inputs.description: The input fill data, to be connected to the output of a Fill node
inputs.name: in

name: Fill to Random Gray

outputs.expr: mix($edgecolor, rand(vec2(float($seed), rand(vec2(rand($(name_uv)_bb.xy), rand($(name_uv)_bb.zw))))), step(0.0000001, dot($(name_uv)_bb.zw, vec2(1.0))))
outputs.label: Output

parameters.description: The value used for the outlines
parameters.label: Edge color
parameters.name: edgecolor
